05 / GOOD TO KNOW

Thoughtful tools.
Straight answers.

Still have a question? Contact us →
Is Manglo really free?+

Yes. All seven current tools are free to use, without an account or subscription. If that changes, any paid features will be clearly labelled.

Do my images get uploaded?+

No. The image tools run in your browser. Images are processed locally; Manglo does not receive your files. Keep a copy of the original and review your export.

Will this work on mobile?+

The tools support modern mobile browsers. Very large files may take longer on devices with limited memory.

Can I trust the profit estimates?+

The calculations use the values you enter. They are planning estimates, not official marketplace statements, tax advice or a substitute for bookkeeping.
